reference.difference: GitLab artifacts belong to an exact job; job download extracts a bounded ZIP. Release download selects one exact link and preserves asset bytes. No pipeline-wide bundle or glob selection is invented.

authentication.authority: existing configured native logical host/API/web mapping
authentication.scope: one credential and authority for all reads, pages, transfer and rechecks in the operation

release_link_targets: configured API origin, same numeric project or escaped project path, packages/generic/{name}/{version}/{filename}
exact configured project web URL, /-/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts/raw/{file_path}, translated to the typed same-project API route

raw_artifact_listing_collision.matching: Case-sensitive entire relative artifact path after one URL percent-decoding, with one optional .json suffix. Reject tree and tree.json including encoded equivalents before transfer; preserve unrelated, other-extension and nested paths.
raw_artifact_listing_collision.basis: GitLab declares the listing before the format:false raw wildcard. API::API declares format :json and only content_type :json; Grape format defines a single MIME type, and Path#suffix uses the literal optional (.json) for that single supported format, not an arbitrary extension.

integrity.job_archive: exact metadata size and complete ZIP CRC verification; returned SHA-256 is locally computed receipt evidence, not a provider digest
integrity.generic_package: unique exact package name/version/type and file identity, provider file_sha256 and size, plus full metadata recheck
integrity.raw_job_asset: exact project/job/pipeline/release commit binding and metadata recheck; returned SHA-256 is locally computed receipt evidence

filesystem.destination: explicit absolute new directory with existing symlink-free parent
filesystem.rollback: recorded operation-owned entries only; foreign entries preserved and incomplete cleanup reported
filesystem.zip: single-disk non-ZIP64; complete bounded directory/path/type/collision/size/CRC validation before extracted-content writes
filesystem.paths: portable ASCII; no links, devices, traversal, case-fold collisions, reserved device names or path replacement through symlinks
filesystem.permissions: private; executable bits are not preserved

residuals: Redirect/CDN/object-storage transfer is refused; no universal private-deployment coverage is claimed.
External or other release link types are refused, not downloaded anonymously as a false equivalent.
Job archive and raw artifact routes provide no pinned SHA-256 metadata; local hashes are not represented as verified provider checksums.
Cooperative cancellation cleans staging; crash/forced-kill recovery and isolation from a malicious same-account process are not claimed.

provider_evidence.delegated_dependency: Pinned glab 1.112.0 has independently reproduced PAT redirect forwarding and unsafe dedicated extraction. It is not used by these native download operations and is not claimed fixed upstream.
